create_laguna_config_default: create a LagunaConfig instance with default model architecture and MoE settings
create_laguna_config_custom_moe: create a LagunaConfig with custom num_experts and num_experts_per_tok values for MoE routing
configure_laguna_rope_scaling: configure a LagunaConfig using rope_parameters to set RoPE theta and scaling type
inspect_laguna_tp_plan: inspect the base_model_tp_plan class attribute to view tensor parallelism sharding strategy
configure_laguna_sliding_window: configure a LagunaConfig with sliding_window and layer_types for sliding window attention
